title: Account ID
summary: Identifier for an Iroha account composed of the domain it belongs to and the account controller (single key or multisig policy) that authorizes actions.
definition: Identifier for an Iroha account composed of the domain it belongs to and the account controller (single key or multisig policy) that authorizes actions.
tagline: Binds an account to its domain and authorization controller for deterministic identity resolution.
